source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 7. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.

learn.en: Allah does not speak to each of us separately. He makes His will known through His prophets and messengers.
learn.title: Through the prophets

learn.en: Allah chooses a person and sends him His message through Angel Jibreel. That person becomes a prophet.
learn.title: Chosen by Allah

learn.en: Allah sent prophets to different peoples at different times. They were noble men who guided people in Allah's name.
learn.title: Every nation

learn.en: The first prophet was Adam. The last prophet is Muhammad ﷺ. Others include Nuh, Ibraheem, Ishaq, Ya'qub, Yusuf, Musa, Haroon, Yunus, Yahya and Isa.
learn.title: From Adam to Muhammad ﷺ

learn.en: “And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, saying: Worship Allah.” (Qur'an 16:36)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

order.en: Put these prophets in order, from first to last

quiz.en: How does Allah make His will known to people?
True or false? Allah sent prophets to different peoples at different times.

think.q: Which prophet's story do you like most? What did he teach his people?
think.a: Every prophet taught the same thing: worship Allah alone.

parents.summary: Allah guides people through prophets chosen by Him, from Adam (the first) to Muhammad ﷺ (the last).
parents.tip: Read one prophet's story together each week.
